import heapq, math

def weighted_pred(img,out,Hx,wall,sources,bgcost,diag=False,source_init='cells'):
 labels=sorted(set(l for comp,l in sources))
 ds={lab:[[math.inf]*Hx for _ in range(Hx)] for lab in labels}
 # target costs: wall 1, bg bgcost, any other region/source cell 0.5 maybe
 src_label={p:l for comp,l in sources for p in comp}
 for p,l in src_label.items(): ds[l][p[0]][p[1]]=0
 hq=[]
 for p,l in src_label.items():heapq.heappush(hq,(0,l,*p))
 steps=[(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]
 if diag:steps += [(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]
 while hq:
  d,l,r,c=heapq.heappop(hq)
  if d!=ds[l][r][c]:continue
  for dr,dc in steps:
   nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
   if not(0<=nr<Hx and 0<=nc<Hx):continue
   v=img[nr][nc]
   # target cost
   if v==wall: cost=1
   elif v in backgrounds_for(img,wall): cost=bgcost
   else: cost=0.5
   nd=d+cost
   if nd<ds[l][nr][nc]:
    ds[l][nr][nc]=nd;heapq.heappush(hq,(nd,l,nr,nc))
 pred=[row[:] for row in img]
 for r in range(Hx):
  for c in range(Hx):
   if img[r][c]!=wall:continue
   vals=[ds[l][r][c] for l in labels]
   m=min(vals); labs=[l for l,v in zip(labels,vals) if abs(v-m)<1e-9]
   pred[r][c]=labs[0] if len(labs)==1 else wall
 return pred,ds
